scope: New Live Notes source context and View Source navigation

native_observation.stage: Historical observation before the fix; retained as reproduction evidence.

cause: TransportBar used the older native extractive summary generator, which saved note strings through addNotes without source context. LiveNotesPanel used a separate source-aware AI path. Matching existing unlinked notes were also discarded by deduplication instead of receiving their source metadata.
fixed: The automatic native generator snapshots its source transcript and stores exact source text, segment IDs, and global indexes with every retained note.
Display normalization such as John chapter three verse sixteen to John 3:16 and native note truncation preserve the complete original source.
A native summary point with no matching captured source is not stored with a guessed source.
Deduplication attaches missing source metadata to a matching old note while preserving its identity, creation time, and queue membership. Repeated drafts within one batch do not duplicate a note.
Native extractive generation keeps the separate AI cursor unchanged, so manual AI generation still processes the captured transcript.

View Source resolves segment identity in the current transcript. Stale indexes cannot highlight unrelated newer text. Historical notes lacking metadata retain the existing unavailable-source fallback.
verified: Four automatic native notes have exact source metadata, including nonzero global session offsets, and metadata is retained in the persisted session payload.
A shortened note retains the complete source segment.
An existing matching unlinked note gains its source without losing its queued identity.
Automatic notes render enabled View Source controls and clicking one scrolls/highlights the exact transcript paragraph.
Manual AI generation through the real parser and store adds source-linked notes without removing automatic note links.
Changed transcript positions follow the stable source segment ID.
A source segment absent from the visible transcript does not cause unrelated text to be highlighted.
A true historical note without metadata still displays the fallback and disables View Source.
limits: This subagent did not make paid calls, access credentials, control the native UI, or capture microphone audio. The main agent performed and reported the real native and cloud checks above.
The four existing unlinked historical test notes are preserved; the fix supplies metadata on new generation and can enrich matching notes when regenerated.
Native View Source was checked on the observed new automatic and manual notes. This does not claim inspection of every note in every session.
